label: Non-concrete-cause rival of the esse-cause bridge survives, checked
description: Rival test for the esse-cause bridge against its smallest consumer, Round2Grounding.contingentGroundedViaParticipation (premises: actual contingent concreta participate esse, participated esse has a distinct cause, the esse-cause bridge). With a non-concrete item causing the esse of a contingent concretum, the rival holds with the other two premises and contingent dependence on an actual concrete ground fails. Model-witnessed survival only.

research_comparisons.conditions: Control.formCause at world false with formCauses and formParticipates: the rival, ContingentConcretumParticipatesEsse and ParticipatedEsseHasDistinctCause hold; EveryContingentGroundedAt fails. Consumer tested: Round2Grounding.contingentGroundedViaParticipation.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Profile, selected world, CausesIn and esse as the premise; two mutually accessible worlds, two candidates.
research_comparisons.coverage: One explicitly populated interpretation; the other failure modes of the bridge (absent cause; concrete cause that is no selected-relation ground) are not tested.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival and the premise cannot both hold on one Profile, world, CausesIn and esse (unregistered helper nonConcreteEsseCause_excludes).
research_comparisons.witness: Control.formCause in Control.NonConcreteEsseCauseSurvives; nonConcreteEsseCauseSurvives proves the listed conjuncts.
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against the principle that causing requires act and the adopted sense of concrete as esse in re: together they would make every cause of esse concrete.
